summary: In the most recent reporting period, Boise State University experienced a mix of incidents, with a notable prevalence of alcohol-related violations and thefts. Specifically, there were multiple alcohol violation referrals, alongside cases of theft, including an e-scooter and other items. Compared to previous months, the data indicates an increase in incidents related to theft and disturbances, while stalking cases remain consistent. The presence of open cases, particularly those involving battery and unlawful entry, suggests ongoing concerns that the campus community should monitor closely.
